- A well-supported inconsistency or clear fraud evidence can justify rejection; CLM-7002’s travel claim was correctly rejected and later confirmed fraudulent.
- Prefer outcomes: approve when adequately supported; request documents/hold when evidence is incomplete; reject only when unsupported after reasonable follow-up or when fraud/coverage exclusion is substantiated.
